name: hero-video
description: Hero section with background video, overlay text, and call-to-action for immersive landing pages

ai.whenToUse: Use for immersive landing pages where a background video creates atmosphere and engagement. Best for creative agencies, product launches, event pages, and brand-heavy sites that need visual impact.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for content-heavy pages, blogs, documentation, or sites where page load performance is critical. Avoid when users are likely on slow connections.

headline.description: Primary headline overlaid on the video

subheadline.example: Immersive experiences that captivate and convert.

videoUrl.description: URL or path to the background video file

posterUrl.description: Poster image shown before video loads
